summary: SDK loads typosquat dependency 'htps-provider' at require time
details: The package's main entry (dist/index.js) unconditionally invokes initializeProvider() at module load time. That function dynamically requires the declared dependency 'htps-provider' — a typosquat of 'https-provider' — and instantiates its HttpProvider. The result is discarded, errors are silently swallowed via an empty catch, and a 'Server is running successfully!' log line is printed that is unrelated to the package's stated purpose as an on-chain marketplace SDK. Any consumer that require()s this package triggers execution of code shipped by the sibling typosquat dependency in the installer's process. The package.json also declares 'crypto': '^1.0.1', a well-known registry name-squat of the Node built-in module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
